comparison_scope: Unmodified upstream Docs.aquery on the same selected PDFs/questions/remote API; not the autonomous upstream literature-search agent.
model_identity_limitation: Underlying automatic model identity and monetary cost are unavailable.
fairness: Within each round, identical literal questions, source PDF bytes, answering token settings and provider aliases; alternating paired order. Workbench uses extra retrieval/review calls and is not an equal-compute comparison.
scoring: Separate remote anonymous scoring plus required Codex source inspection; not an external human expert panel. Unreviewed agreements retain fallible remote judgments.
round_rules: Round 1 original card-completeness rules retained. Round 2 prospectively makes literal questions authoritative and neutralizes unasked gold-card demands. No across-round pooled significance or direct improvement claim from changed scoring rules.
field_labels: Broad descriptive topic strata assigned before answering; overlap exists. Statistics includes numerical computing, economics includes energy-system planning, and physics includes engineering. Round 2 publisher-repository candidates were classified from titles by the remote service; these are not expert-certified mutually exclusive disciplines.
exclusions: Round 2 source/card exclusions occurred before any answers, all acquisition/card failures retained. Every frozen question and answer failure included.
text_limitations: Text-based PDF ingestion can lose formula layout, superscripts or plotted values. Original rendered pages are consulted in source review; this does not add vision to the answering software.
corpus_limitations: Round 2 contains 48 predominantly short English JOSS software papers and three longer arXiv papers, with English questions. This does not establish performance for all scientific genres, languages, scanned PDFs or clinical applications.
scoring_repairs: One unused identical-text same-document duplicate citation alias was mechanically removed only from scoring input. Literal quote anchors were repaired without changing scientific ratings; original inputs, errors and reviews retained.
posthoc_source_error: The controlled round-2 final analysis adds a matched Molass Figure2 review after native inspection revealed a gold-card error: three components are visible in the original image. Both answers lose strict success for omitting the known requested count. Original planned 98-case review and metrics are retained; no question or answer removed or regenerated.
timing_limitations: Controlled common embedding cache was prewarmed; native upstream chunks were not. Reported durations and token counts are observed, not equal-compute cost or isolated cold-start benchmarks.
